title: EVPN BGP Session Down — dc1-leaf2a L2VPN EVPN AF
symptom: dc1-leaf2a L2VPN EVPN session to dc1-spine1 is down (Connect state). Underlay IPv4 sessions are all Established.
root_cause: EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS peer group deactivated under address-family evpn on dc1-leaf2a. Underlay unaffected.
fix_command:
router bgp 65102
address-family evpn
neighbor EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS activate
